I cannot afford chemical fertilizer this season because the shop prices are too high and I was not able to get a FISP coupon from the extension office. I will plant the local maize seed I saved from last year and mix in manure from my goats to give the soil some strength. My children and I will do all the ridging, planting, and weeding ourselves because we do not have cash to pay for ganyu labor. We rely only on the rains since there is no water source close enough to irrigate this small field.
